queries.query:
WITH spp AS (
  SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'SPP'
), wind AS (
  SELECT fuel_id FROM core.dim_fuel WHERE fuel_code = 'wind'
), gen AS (
  SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generation_mwh
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN spp s ON g.iso_id = s.iso_id
  JOIN wind w ON g.fuel_id = w.fuel_id
  WHERE CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
), curtailed AS (
  SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_mwh
  FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min c
  JOIN spp s ON c.iso_id = s.iso_id
  JOIN wind w ON c.fuel_id = w.fuel_id
  WHERE CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh / (gen.generation_mwh + curtailed.curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_percentage
FROM gen CROSS JOIN curtailed

SELECT SUM(q.capacity_mw) AS proposed_capacity_mw
FROM core.queue_project AS q
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON q.iso_id = i.iso_id
JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON q.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'PJM'
  AND f.fuel_code = 'battery'
  AND q.status_code = 'active'
  AND q.is_hybrid = FALSE
  AND q.proposed_cod < DATE '2029-01-01';

SELECT AVG(p.clearing_price) AS avg_spinning_reserve_clearing_price_usd_per_mw_hour
FROM core.isone_ancillary_prices_hourly AS p
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON p.iso_id = i.iso_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
  AND p.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 00:00:00'
  AND p.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-17 00:00:00'
  AND p.service_code = 'spinning_reserve';

WITH peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
),
peak_hours AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
    FROM peak
    WHERE rn = 1
),
shares AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id,
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
                 / NULLIF(MAX(b.net_generation_mw), 0) AS share_pct
    FROM peak_hours p
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
      ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
      ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN s.share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN s.share_pct END) AS answer
FROM shares s
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.outage_type = 'planned' THEN o.unavailable_mw ELSE 0 END) / SUM(o.unavailable_mw) AS planned_percentage FROM core.miso_resource_outage_daily AS o JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON o.iso_id = i.iso_id WHERE i.iso_code = 'MISO' AND o.market_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-15' AND DATE '2026-10-21';
SELECT SUM(o.unavailable_mw) AS unavailable_mw FROM core.miso_resource_outage_daily AS o JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON o.iso_id = i.iso_id WHERE i.iso_code = 'MISO' AND o.market_date = DATE '2026-10-18'

SELECT p.lmp AS lmp_usd_per_mwh
FROM core.nyiso_lmp_rt_bus_5min AS p
JOIN core.dim_location AS l ON p.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON p.iso_id = i.iso_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'NYISO'
  AND l.location_code = 'NYISO_BUS_B'
  AND p.interval_start_local = TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 17:10:00'

SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_wind_mwh FROM core.ercot_renewable_curtailment_5min AS c JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON c.iso_id = i.iso_id JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON c.fuel_id = f.fuel_id WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' AND f.fuel_code = 'wind' AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-17'

SELECT SUM(o.unavailable_mw) AS forced_outage_mw
FROM core.miso_resource_outage_daily AS o
JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON o.iso_id = i.iso_id
JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON o.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'MISO'
  AND o.market_date = DATE '2026-10-21'
  AND f.fuel_code = 'natural_gas'
  AND o.outage_type = 'forced';

WITH loc AS (
  SELECT location_id
  FROM core.dim_location
  WHERE location_code = 'CAISO_HUB' AND location_type = 'hub'
), daily AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(lmp) FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min rt JOIN loc USING (location_id) WHERE rt.iso_id = 1 AND rt.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND rt.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00') AS rt_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(lmp) FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly da JOIN loc USING (location_id) WHERE da.iso_id = 1 AND da.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND da.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00') AS da_avg
)
SELECT rt_avg - da_avg AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM daily

SELECT SUM(discharge_mw) * (5.0 / 60.0) AS discharge_mwh
FROM core.spp_storage_dispatch_5min d
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON d.iso_id = i.iso_id
WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
  AND CAST(d.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'

WITH balance AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), renewables AS (
  SELECT g.interval_start_utc, SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON g.iso_id = i.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id = f.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
  GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), netload AS (
  SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw - r.wind_solar_mw AS net_load_mw
  FROM balance b JOIN renewables r USING (interval_start_utc)
  ORDER BY net_load_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), rt_hour AS (
  SELECT r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON r.iso_id = i.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id AND l.iso_id = r.iso_id
  JOIN netload n ON r.interval_start_utc >= n.interval_start_utc AND r.interval_start_utc < n.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), rt_hour_agg AS (
 SELECT AVG(rt_avg_lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp FROM rt_hour
), da AS (
 SELECT AVG(d.lmp) AS da_lmp
 FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
 JOIN core.dim_iso i ON d.iso_id = i.iso_id
 JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id = l.location_id AND l.iso_id = d.iso_id
 JOIN netload n ON d.interval_start_utc = n.interval_start_utc
 WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO' AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
)
SELECT rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.da_lmp AS answer_usd_per_mwh
FROM rt_hour_agg rt CROSS JOIN da

WITH balance AS (
 SELECT b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
 JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id=i.iso_id
 WHERE i.iso_code='CAISO' AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20'
), renewables AS (
 SELECT g.interval_start_utc, SUM(g.generation_mw) AS renew_mw
 FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g JOIN core.dim_iso i ON g.iso_id=i.iso_id JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON g.fuel_id=f.fuel_id
 WHERE i.iso_code='CAISO' AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE)=DATE '2026-10-20' AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar')
 GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), selected_hour AS (
 SELECT b.interval_start_utc FROM balance b JOIN renewables r USING(interval_start_utc)
 ORDER BY b.demand_mw-r.renew_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
 SELECT AVG(x.lmp) AS price FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min x JOIN core.dim_location l ON x.location_id=l.location_id
 JOIN selected_hour h ON x.interval_start_utc>=h.interval_start_utc AND x.interval_start_utc<h.interval_start_utc+INTERVAL '1 hour'
 WHERE x.iso_id=1 AND l.location_code='CAISO_HUB'
), da AS (
 SELECT AVG(x.lmp) AS price FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly x JOIN core.dim_location l ON x.location_id=l.location_id
 JOIN selected_hour h ON x.interval_start_utc=h.interval_start_utc
 WHERE x.iso_id=1 AND l.location_code='CAISO_HUB'
)
SELECT rt.price-da.price AS answer_usd_per_mwh FROM rt CROSS JOIN da
